spans.s: DG0045 औषधि auṣadhi herbs having limited life cycle till fruiting or maturity i.e. annual plants

SV0049 औषधि युक्त भोजन auṣadhi yukta bhojana Medicine mixed with food- for those who have aversion to words the medicines, for them food should be given mixed with medicine. Childrens and alpa Satva persons will come under this categories.
